rules: Current authority is checked before every private read, write and replay.
Only a released purchase permits its buyer one review; buyer and seller must differ.
Only the current seller representative permits one reply, never removal.
Only an assigned moderator independent of buyer, seller and every reporter may adjudicate.
Reports and decisions retain reasons privately. Public rows exclude identities and private reasons.
Identical retries return the retained result; changed payloads conflict.
Missing or timed out current facts remain unavailable. Retry the same operation.
Registration and provider composition belong to the runtime owner.

public_item.review_ref: Stable opaque reference; no purchase or identity data.
